meta.name: accessibility
meta.description: Audit and improve web accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Use when asked to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".

copy.tagline: 审计并提升网页无障碍合规性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保网站符合无障碍标准并改善用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and improve web accessibility compliance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your website meets accessibility standards and improves user experience.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会按照 WCAG 2.2 标准审核网页的无障碍性，并给出改进建议，包括添加图片替代文本、确保键盘可操作、提高颜色对比度等。
howto.when: 当用户要求“改善无障碍性”、“进行无障碍审计”、“符合 WCAG”、“支持屏幕阅读器”、“键盘导航”或“让内容无障碍”时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个网页的无障碍性。
say.note: Claude 会分析网页并列出问题。

say.text: 如何让我的网站支持屏幕阅读器？
say.note: Claude 会提供具体代码和模式。

say.text: 检查颜色对比度是否符合 AA 标准。
say.note: Claude 会给出对比度建议。

howto.what_en: Claude audits web pages for accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines and provides improvement suggestions, such as adding alt text, ensuring keyboard operability, and improving color contrast.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and list issues.

say_en.text: How do I make my site screen-reader friendly?
Check color contrast for AA compliance.
